temporal_forecast.summary: Heavy orographic rainfall across Teesta Valley and Dima Hasao ghats. Shear stress approaching critical threshold.
Radar cell intensification over Sikkim NH-10 corridor. Pore pressure rising at 1.8 kPa/min.
Peak cloudburst envelope crossing Dikchu & Mangan. Factor of safety dropping below stability limit.
Widespread colluvial soil failure expected along steep cut-slopes. Mandatory road closures recommended.
Rain cell moving eastward into Arunachal Pradesh. High residual saturation hazard remains active.

risk_drivers_explanation.critical_trigger: Antecedent 72h precipitation (265 mm) saturated the colluvial wedge on a 34.8° slope, exceeding pore pressure stability limits.

recommended_actions: Issue immediate traffic diversion advisory for NH-10 via NH-717A Lava route
Pre-position SDRF Pakyong battalion rescue team at Singtam staging area
Broadcast CAP emergency SMS watch to 1,420 residents in Dikchu & Lower Singtam
Deploy PWD / BRO earthmoving machinery on standby at KM 18 checkpost
